newsitem.title: PERU: RESEARCH ALERT - Santander downgrades Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Santander downgrades Telefonica.

text.p: Santander Investment said Friday it had downgraded its rating on Telefonica del Peru shares to market perform from buy.

-- "Santander lowered its earnings per share estimates to $1.77 and $2.11 for 1997 and 1998 respectively, from $2.03 and $2.45," a statement from Santander added. "The 12-month target price of $31.50 implies 16 percent upside."

-- The statement said that Santander believes the market "is not yet fully discounting increased competition in the cellular market from Tele 2000 and revenue per line dilution from further penetration into the lower-income segments, as a result of the saturation of the higher-income segments."

-- It added that Peru's economic recovery, which should lead to higher income line penetration and a pick-up in volumes, will support Telefonica's growth in 1997, but not offset a slowdown in 1998 "as Telefonica penetrates further into the lower-income segments."
-- In Lima, Telefonica was unchanged at 7.11 soles. Telefonica is the bellwether issue of the Lima bolsa.
-- In New York, Telefonica's ADRs were up 3/16 to 27-1/4.
